AccessChange.description: The person's full desired switch set, and the `on` set the page loaded it from.
AccessChange.title: AccessChange

AccessEvent.description:
One change: a save on this page, or access set on an invitation when it was accepted.

For an invitation the actor is whoever chose the preset, and `turned_on` is the switches the
preset added to what the person already had. A platform admin's name is "FourStacks admin";
a name is None once that person is no longer an enabled member.
AccessEvent.title: AccessEvent

AccessWarningOut.description: Names are resolved by the server; the page writes the sentence.
AccessWarningOut.title: AccessWarningOut

AccountLink.description: Link a person to a member's console account, or unlink (None). HR owner only.
AccountLink.title: AccountLink

AttentionPage.description: Up to ten threads that need the member's attention, from the last sync's stored mail.
AttentionPage.title: AttentionPage

ComposeRequest.description:
A new email: one To recipient (a directory employee or a plain address), optional CC/BCC.

CC and BCC entries are directory employee ids or plain addresses.
ComposeRequest.title: ComposeRequest

ConfirmationAccept.description: Opaque path reference only; callers cannot replace the prepared command.
ConfirmationAccept.title: ConfirmationAccept

ContributionBand-Input.description: An explicitly reviewed wage band, rather than an inferred flat percentage.
ContributionBand-Input.title: ContributionBand

ContributionBand-Output.description: An explicitly reviewed wage band, rather than an inferred flat percentage.
ContributionBand-Output.title: ContributionBand

DepartmentSave.description: Create (no expected_version), rename, archive or restore a department.
DepartmentSave.title: DepartmentSave

DirectoryValues.description: Allowlist only. Salary/bank/medical/CV values have no representation here.
DirectoryValues.title: DirectoryValues

version.description: `draft_version` of this draft: what `/send` and a send card are bound to.
version.title: Version

DraftUpdate.description: An edit by the person. `recipient` alone is the older single-address form of `to`.
DraftUpdate.title: DraftUpdate

disclosure.default: Analyse and Draft send the selected email text to the configured model provider. Nothing is sent to anyone; drafts are saved locally or to your own Gmail drafts.
disclosure.title: Disclosure

HrGuidance.description: Ephemeral grant summary, not a resource authorization or workflow result.
HrGuidance.title: HrGuidance

LocalOrderSummary.description: Bounded manual-business projection; no contact, address or provider blob.
LocalOrderSummary.title: LocalOrderSummary

PayrollInput.description: Request to prepare a human-reviewed run, without wages in agent/model input.
PayrollInput.title: PayrollInput

PendingInvitationAccess.description: An accepted invitation whose HR access was neither applied nor dismissed.
PendingInvitationAccess.title: PendingInvitationAccess

PersonAdd.description: A new active person. Owner or Manage people; never changes access or account links.
PersonAdd.title: PersonAdd

PersonUpdate.description: Every editable field at once. Never changes whether the person is active (1b).
PersonUpdate.title: PersonUpdate

PersonValues.description:
A person's editable Overview fields, for person.add and person.update.

The department is an existing one (`department_id`) or a name typed in the form
(`new_department`, matched like department names are, or created), never both.
PersonValues.title: PersonValues

ReplyRequest.description: A reply in a synced thread. The To address comes from the thread, never from here.
ReplyRequest.title: ReplyRequest

ResolvedGrant.description: Trusted permission resolution, NOT a login or a caller-selectable HR role.
ResolvedGrant.title: ResolvedGrant

ReviewedPayrollAmounts.description:
Private, manually reviewed input. Never an agent argument or generic fact.

Statutory amounts must come from a reviewed effective-dated rule set; this
arithmetic does not implement or certify EPF/SOCSO/EIS/PCB statutory rules.
ReviewedPayrollAmounts.title: ReviewedPayrollAmounts

SendResult.description: The outcome of one send. An unknown outcome is refused as `send_outcome_unknown`.
SendResult.title: SendResult

StoreConnection.description: Local lifecycle observation, never a current provider authorization decision.
StoreConnection.title: StoreConnection

TrainingCommandInput.description: Untrusted intent; request/employee/actor/grants come from verified state.
TrainingCommandInput.title: TrainingCommandInput

TrainingDraftInput.description: Untrusted content proposal, not an employee identity or persisted request.
TrainingDraftInput.title: TrainingDraftInput

TrainingProjection.description: Authorized request view; omits internal decision identity and private note.
TrainingProjection.title: TrainingProjection

TrainingReceipt.description: Returned only after a successful domain transaction commit (or exact replay).
TrainingReceipt.title: TrainingReceipt
